notes: *with the hammer* is kept with הָלְמָה because the supplied instrument writes that denominative verb's own lexeme (rule 44's subtraction test), and the ASV does not italicize it; reading *the hammer* instead as a second realization of the written הַלְמוּת under rule 25's resumption sentence, with *with* left added, was the competing reading.
The ASV inverts the last two verbs: מָחֲצָה is matched to *struck through* and חָלְפָה to *pierced* on lexical grounds, the units interleaving under rule 25.
יְמִינָהּ divides into *right hand* headed on *right* (rule 31) and the suffix's *her* (rule 18); the recast possessive *the workmen's hammer* puts the determiner on the possessor's word (rule 29).
